context: A vendor and cafe owner finalize a long-term contract
purpose: Teach: 引き下げ/免除/落札/需給/補完/著名/完結/出入り

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本日は契約の件で伺いました。需給の動向を踏まえて、来期から納入価格の引き下げをご相談したいんです。
lines.en: I've come today about the contract. Given supply and demand trends, we'd like to discuss a price reduction from next term.
lines.style: Polite businesslike tone, measured and slightly firm negotiator voice

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 正直、厳しいですね。先日の豆の入札でうちが落札した価格自体が高くて、こちらも余裕がなくて。
lines.en: Honestly, that's tough. The price we won at the recent bean auction was already high, so we have no margin either.
lines.style: Warm but candid cafe-owner voice, slightly worried and sincere

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 事情は承知しています。その代わり、最低発注量を保証して、初年度は配送料の免除という形でこちらが補完します。
lines.en: I understand the situation. In exchange, we'll guarantee minimum orders and waive delivery fees the first year to compensate.
lines.style: Calm, problem-solving corporate tone with reassuring cadence

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それは助かります。実はうちの店、著名な雑誌に載ってから、店の出入り口に列ができるくらいお客さんが増えて。
lines.en: That really helps. Since a famous magazine featured us, lines have formed at our entrance — customers have really grown.
lines.style: Brightening slightly, proud yet humble small-business owner voice

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 存じております。だからこそ長期で組みたいんです。三年契約で、双方の不安要素を完全に解消したくて。
lines.en: I'm aware. That's exactly why we want a long-term deal — three years to fully resolve mutual concerns on both sides.
lines.style: Confident, forward-looking, with quiet conviction in her pitch

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 三年は長いですが、安定するならありがたいです。ただ、品質基準だけはこちらの言い分も通させてください。
lines.en: Three years is long, but stability is welcome. Just let our quality standards have weight too, please.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently assertive about craft and standards in negotiation

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: もちろんです。九月下旬を目処に協議を完結させて、正式契約という方向で社内に持ち帰らせていただきます。
lines.en: Of course. We'll aim to conclude discussions by late September and move toward a formal contract — I'll take this back internally.
lines.style: Closing tone, polished and conclusive, businesslike warmth in her delivery

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。今日はゆっくりコーヒーでも飲んでいってください。一杯、サービスしますね。
lines.en: Thank you. Please stay and enjoy a coffee — this one's on the house today.
lines.style: Relaxed and friendly, returning to barista mode with genuine hospitality
